findings.verification: Before fix: extended Swift test failed four assertions and both React remount cases failed. After fix: `XLOG_PORTABLE_ONLY=1 swift test --scratch-path .build/prototype-tests --no-parallel --filter 'OperatorDraft|DraftPower|SpotDraft'` PASS 93 tests/10 suites; focused six-file Vitest run PASS 154; final validator/session rerun PASS 41 (overlap); `npm run build` PASS tsc/Vite/unchanged window-bundle budgets. Initial build exceeded Logbook budget by 26, then 4 bytes; equivalent compact validation restored the gate without raising it.
findings.limits: Source/fixture verification only. No native/installed UI, provider, station or production-data operation. No retrospective rewrite of old contacts. Legacy renderer journals without provenance remain readable; production editors conservatively show their retained timestamp until a fresh native snapshot arrives.
findings.fix: Resolve current Save from current.automaticStart, independently of the next blank's automatic provenance. Canonical forms submit unchanged start for automatic drafts so the pre-save replacement cannot accidentally clear the native flag. Transactions, revision fences, power and replay behavior retained.
findings.tests: Extended automatic/manual persistence test through manual Save with explicit end, ADIF date/time, exact replay, fresh connection/readback, durable receipt and next automatic blank; existing automatic Save is the control.
